title: Every country, they say, our own distressful included, has the government it deserves
html_source: This is essentially a reference to Plutarch’s Lives in which a law maker named Solon refers to a question made by a woman in her dotage outside the Parliament “I hope you have endowed us with the best laws that exist?” to which Solon replies “Yes, we have been endowed with the best laws that we "deserve”“.
